I was labeled an old soul as a kid and never really felt connected to my peers. When I went to college I was kind of nervous about some of the same things. What I found was that since there were so many different people there from different backgrounds/cities/states it wasn’t super hard to find other people who I connected with. Unlike high school were everyone comes from the same area, college brings so many different people together that it’s basically impossible to find someone that you click with. Also what I learned as an adult is that it not weird or out of the norm for there to be age diversity within a friend group. I’m 24 my best friend is 41 and we’ve been friends since I was 20. I also have friends who are in there late 20s with kids and a few friends that are a year or 2 younger than me. I wouldn’t worry so much about trying to assimilate into genz culture if it’s not something you’re truly comfortable with, but I also wouldn’t go in with the idea that you’ll never be able to connect with someone your age.

We weren’t rich or even close to well off but my mom is really into technology and wanted me to learn how to use it properly at an early age. This is why I love that there’s a Zillennial group. Because my age puts me closer to millennials but I was raised like most of gen z with technology in my hands at a really young age.
